page.overview:
Who is Boris?

Boris is a Soviet intelligence operative employed by the KGB. A minor character portrayed by Chris Webb, he appeared briefly in the 1977 film The Spy Who Loved Me.

Boris and Ivan confronted James Bond, alongside their handler, Anya Amasova, while both sides are seeking a computer chip held by Aziz Fekkesh. Although Fekkesh was by this point dead at the hands of killed by the assassin Jaws, who also took the chip, the British and Soviet men fight while Amasova watches. Despite their KGB training, Bond easily bests both men and quips to his Soviet opposite that she should have a good night before departing.
